test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which wildlife sanctuary was established in West Bengal in 1941 primarily to protect the great Indian rhinoceros (Rhinoceros unicornis)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaldapara Wildlife Sanctuary.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jaldapara National Park is situated in Ali Purduar of West Bengal**, India, nearby the Indo-Bhutan International Border.
 
• Jaldapara Forests were constituted as Wildlife Sanctuary** in the year 1941 for the protection of ****wildlife, particularly one-horned Rhinoceros **and it was declared as Jaldapara National park in May 2012.
 
• The total area covers 216.51 square kilometres.
 
• It belongs in the heavy rainfall zone, so the forest is mainly Savannah covered with tall elephant Grasses.
 
• River Torsha runs through the national park.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Bandipur National Park**

 
• Established in the year 1974 as a forest tiger reserve under the **Project Tiger**, **Bandipur is the most prominent national park located in the south Indian state of Karnataka.**
 
• This park is famous for its wildlife riches. The park covers 874 square km, which covers many endangered species of animals and flora.

**Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary**

 
• **The Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary located in Thekkady, Kerala** is the perfect example of nature's bounty with great scenic beauty and rich biodiversity.
 
• The wildlife sanctuary which was established in 1982 is home to many exotic Indian animal species such as:
 
 
• Indian tigers
 
• Indian elephants
 
• Sambar
 
• Lion tailed Macaque
 
• Nilgiri Langur
 
 
 
• The park is located in the Western Ghats passing through Kerala.
 
• The protected area of the park spans for 925 square kilometers.

**Barda Wildlife Sanctuary**

 
• **Barda Wildlife Sanctuary is located in Gujarat.**
 
• Previous to its 1979 establishment as a wildlife sanctuary, Barda was a private reserve for Porbandar and Jamnagar.
